text:
sara_support: Customer (acct: acme-corp) flagged a problem — their daily CSV export for 2024-10-09 shows most token rows assigned to 2024-10-08. Console charts show a drop right at midnight PST. They say reconciliation/billing is off. Attached sample CSV and screenshots (redacted link). Any idea?

rajesh_analytics: We saw a similar issue a while back where the charts used org.timezone but exports defaulted to UTC. Do we know the org timezone for acme-corp? :thinking:

sara_support: Org timezone is America/Los_Angeles. Sample CSV row: 
'user_id,token_count,usage_day,start_time'
'uid123,452,2024-10-08,2024-10-09T00:12:34-07:00'
They expect usage_day=2024-10-09.

tom_oncall: Can you paste the export job id or link so I can check the logs?

sara_support: Job id is export_20241009_9876. Download link: https://internal-exports/acme/export_9876.csv (internal).

tom_oncall: Looking at service logs — export service received tz param 'America/Los_Angeles' but the CSV writer calls convert_to_day(ts) which uses floor_ts_utc internally. Repro idea: rerun export with tz param and compare the day column.

rajesh_analytics: That would shift any events between 00:00-06:59 PDT (UTC-7) into the previous UTC day label in the CSV. Charts that do correct local bucketing would show them on Oct 9 while CSV shows Oct 8.

lisa_prod: Quick patch would be to change csv_day = localize(ts, tz).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') instead of utcdate(ts). We should canary it because many cached exports assume UTC labeling.

maria_billing: Customer has already reconciled using the console charts (which matched their local day) and now CSV mismatch is causing their finance team to flag us. They want corrected CSVs and a note on credits. Let's prepare corrected exports first; we can discuss credits after root cause confirmed.

tom_oncall: I'll run a hotfix canary in staging for acme-corp and re-run job 9876 with corrected conversion. Quick repro steps I'm running:
1) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/9876?tz=America/Los_Angeles'
2) check 'usage_day' column vs /v1/usage?date=2024-10-09&tz=America/Los_Angeles
3) compare totals.

sara_support: Thanks — I'll message the customer: fix in progress, corrected CSV within 2 hours. Looping in @emily_support for comms.

emily_support: :thumbsup: I'll draft the message and include the corrected export once available. Any ETA on the canary?

tom_oncall: ETA ~45m for canary + validation, then production regen. Will post validation logs here.

export-bot: Job export_20241009_9876 requeued by tom_oncall at 1762387500.
